compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD1: integration test merges story A into the session branch, then queries DefenseStore.load_for_region from a final-PR-context session and asserts story A's attestations are returned (not stale-invalidated)

## Test Approach
Given: a git repo with story branch A containing commits C1..C2 (story_branch_base_sha=C1, story_branch_tip_sha=C2), a defense record stored for that range, and a session branch that merges story A
When: defense_store_load_for_region is called from the post-merge context (HEAD = merge commit)
Then: the defense record is returned (SHA-range membership confirmed via ancestry-path)

Given: the same scenario but with a subsequent rebase that removes C1..C2 from ancestry
When: defense_store_load_for_region is called
Then: the defense record is NOT returned (SHA-range membership fails)

## Implementation Notes
Create tests/review/test-defense-store-merge-survival.sh:
- Sets up a real git repo with two branches (story and session)
- Writes a defense record with story_branch_tip_sha and story_branch_base_sha via TICKET_CMD stub
- Merges story branch into session
- Calls defense_store_load_for_region with DSO_QUERY_SHA=<merge-commit-sha>
- Asserts the record is returned in the first case, not returned in the rebased case

Use mktemp -d for temp git repos. Source review-defense-store.sh with TICKET_CMD stub.
Update .test-index with RED marker [test_defense_store_merge_survival].

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/review/test-defense-store-merge-survival.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/review/test-defense-store-merge-survival.sh
- [ ] Test contains test_defense_store_merge_survival function
  Verify: grep -q 'test_defense_store_merge_survival' tests/review/test-defense-store-merge-survival.sh
- [ ] Test exits 1 (RED) before implementation
  Verify: bash tests/review/test-defense-store-merge-survival.sh; test $? -ne 0
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_defense_store_merge_survival] for review-defense-store.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_defense_store_merge_survival\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
